avis.texte: Lost count of how many bottles I have bought of this. Easy to apply. Just a couple of minutes until you're left with the softest, smoothest baby like skin. Removing that dead skin layer is a game changer.

I've always struggled with even skin tone/texure and blemishes. With consistent use (approximately a month or so), the Liquid Peelfoliant has helped my skin tremendously! My face is smoother and I see less breakouts than I used to. This product can be irritating at first, so you should start slowly with it. I'm up to using it every day now and have seen a HUGE difference in my skin!

avis.titre: I will buy this product over and over again
avis.texte: I was hesitant to purchase this product but I'm so happy I did.

Great product! I bought this to take the place of another glycolic acid product I had been using for a few years. I was really nervous about switching products but it has not disappointed!! My skin is very soft and smooth, and it did not turn my sensitive skin red or cause irritation. It's definitely a keeper.
This has really helped the appearance of the pores on and around my nose. It doesn't irrational my skin and has made a noticeable difference in my skin care routine.
I can feel this product working. It leaves my skin feeling incredibly soft.

This peel is really phenomenal. I was very surprised at first to see that it suggested 1-3min only to keep it on, but it really does work very quickly to smooth out your skin! After every time I use it, my skin is very smooth and it's helped take a way a lot of my texture too. I need to be more consistent with it, but even just once a week has made a difference! You should definitely purchase it, it's worth the money and lasts a very long time because a little goes a long way!
Helps face to stay smooth from bumps. Keeps skin looking good
This product has made a huge difference for my skin! I've always had uneven texture and tone and its improved my skin more than any other product I've tried.
My skin feels great, I can really see and feel the difference !

Hesitated on purchasing this product but it's quick, easy and leaves your face extremely smooth. Good for also keeping your face free from pimples and discolouration. Has a glowy effect that I love! Will be repurchasing!
I only used it once but it does exactly what it says even skin tone unclogs pores reducing fine lines and wrinkles and I had a glow after I'll be using it more
This is an amazing product! It makes my skin so soft and evens the tone.

This stuff is fantastic. After cleansing, I massage 1 dropper full of product all over my face and leave it on for 3 minutes and rinse off. My skin feels nice and smooth immediately after. The next day I couldnt help but catch glimpses of my skin when I would pass a mirror because it LOOKED smooth and more even in tone. It just looked like I had really healthy skin. I noticed that my pores became teeny tiny also. I usually use the Daily Microfoliant but this product is great for a deeper exfoliation. I will definitely be keeping this in my skincare rotation.

I just finished my first bottle of this, and it has completely changed my skin. I have hormonal acne and since I've been using this (about 3 months) it's almost non existent. it can tingle a little bit but I've only found it to be when my skin is damp or my sores are wide open from a hot shower. It says to leave it on for a minute every other day I think, but I wear it for longer periods of time (5ish minutes) 1-2 a week.

I was hesitant to use this as I have very sensitive skin. I used as directed and built up to every day use. This has seriously been a game changer and gives my skin the most beautiful glow. I will be repurchasing forever, I hope they never stop making this.

I just turned 40 and a few years ago i waa introduced to products like this ans i promise you they make all the difference. I switched from beauty counter to this when it bc out of stock. Did not think anything could be better than beauty counter but i was worng this product is amazing. My skin glows it looks so youthful and i get compliments all the time. If your skin is looking dull this will be the fix. Worth the price!

This wont just change your skin, it could change your religion. The results are boom, first time use. So perfectly thin to spread maybe 4-6 drops scross your fsce and neck quickly. Love this product. Waited three weeks to post this review to be sure it wasnt just love at first sight. It is for real.

avis.titre: Absolutely will buy again! Love my skin!
avis.texte: I'll start with how I use this then describe the products pros. This is most effective if used as a night routine product. So I start out by washing my face with Dermalogica special cleansing gel, then I apply this peelfoliant to my clean dry skin. I leave it on for 3-5min approx depending on how much I need done to my skin. Then I rinse off and I apply Dermalogica deep rich repair face cream. It's a really simple 3 step night routine to get amazing results and wake up with glowing skin. This peel goes on like a serum. It's very light and there's no bad smells it's actually a pleasant scent. It absorbs nicely besides a light layer which is what washes off. I typically feel a light tingle but nothing dramatic or too intense just enough so you know it's doing its job. After I rinse it my skin immediately feels smooth! My face is red afterwards but I expect that and it does not bother me. It lets me know it's working it did its job and I know I'm going to be glowing in the morning. It doesn't cause flaky skin for me. It just tightens my pores and makes my skin look and feel brand new. My skin just feels rejuvenated. It does NOT make me breakout at all! I do not have acne prone skin though either. But some products have caused a zit to come out which is in my picture but it was from a different product that I returned lol hoping this peel will help get rid of it cause my skin is like we don't get zits but if you're gonna get one it's gonna be a monster haha. I'll post pictures of

I was neevous to try this since i have sensitive skin, but wow am I impressed! This liquid exfoliant makes my skin softer, look brighter, and minimizes pores and breakouts without irritation! I love how i can INSTANTLY see results and there is zero burning, redness, or dryness. Such a great product

avis.titre: I will not stop buying this product
avis.texte: This product is excellent it exceeded all my expectations I have very sensitive skin and it dit the job without irritating me ❤️
I absolutely love this face peel for its remarkable ability to make my skin beautifully smooth, glowing, and irresistibly radiant, which is why it's my favourite.

Have added this to my skin care routine; very simply - its great and one of my favorite products. It works without over sensitizing my sensitive skin, my skin is clear and I notice increased brightening. Strongly recommend this product!
Such a great product for hormonal acne support during that time of the month. Makes my skin so soft and acne looks reduced after each use!

I really like this product and after one week, I am already seeing a difference in my skin. On the bottle it suggests using this product every other day until one's skin gets use and that's good advice because the first two times the product sting, but there was no irritation which is a good thing. I use the product at bedtime...and I awake to a brighter and clearer, skin...can't wait to see what the future holds using this product.
I started using this every other day since Christmas. So I'm not sure if i see a difference yet. But i like the consistency, smell and feel to it.
Tried a sample of this product two times. I found it to be a bit of a sticky mess to put on and I didn't notice any benefits. Would not purchase.

I have been using this product for a little over a month. Started out slowly three times a week and now using every day. Just within this short period of time I have noticed a difference in the appearance of my skin, looking smoother and brighter. I went for my monthly facial last week and my esthetician noticed the difference asking me what did I add to my skin care regime.

I've been using this product for a week now and I notice my face looks smoother and it has balanced out my uneven skin tone. I love the results of this liquid peelfoliant. No need for a chemical peel at the dermatologist. This works great!
Leaves my skin feeling soft and not dry and the oily areas stays oil free for quite awhile
Pleasing smell. Makes my skin feel clean and smooth. People have been complimenting my skin.
Not sure what the hype is. Expensive and the bottle doesn't come full with product.
I really like the way this helps my skin to look clearer and healthy. I have oily skin consequently my pores are rather large. This really make a difference.
Loved this as a sample and saw the difference after two uses! Exciting new product from dermalogica. Did leave me with some redness.
I was following all instructions, used for the first time before going to bed my skin was completely fine. In the morning woked up with itchy,red cheeks. This peel is not as mild as it's advertised!
You need this product! It has changed my skincare routine and woken up my skin to a much more radient appearance. It's amazing to use to prep skin for slugging overnight. Must have.

I bought this hoping it was like the liquid multi vitamin power exfoliant tubes I used in the past. Liquid peelfoliant was easier to apply but the results were not the same as it only made my face red.

Wow this stuff will really clean out your pores!! This is helping me get some closed comadones to the surface faster than anything i've ever used!! Pores look very smooth and skin looks bright and clean. Wow great stuff here!!

My skin is combinations and sensitive, I have melisma and acne prone skin, it also dries in some areas. This liquid peel is perfect for me. I can leave it on and makes my skin feel clean and fresh. I think it has help keep melisma lighter.
Surprisingly effective! I wasn't sure what to expect but this is a game changer as part of my skin program

I'm 86 & was concerned about this possibly being too strong for me however it was wonderful - no tingle, didn't feel it at all - left it on for about 10 minutes, my skin felt so soft & silky after, rinses right off easily. Very pleased!
So far the best product I use. Makes skin smooth and refreshed.
Definitely a winner for for a beautiful face. Application to face is pretty smooth
It helped with my acne, a good exfoliating treatment for my face

avis.titre: BOUGHT WITH MY OWN MONEY TO TRY
avis.texte: PLEASE READ CAREFULLY! This wasn't gifted by Dermalogica. I bought this myself to try it. And let me tell you, this saved me from going to my usual expensive blue led light therapy facial to combat acne on my favorite med spa nearby. No lies. Promise. It brightens my skin together with daily microfoliant that I really love. Also I noticed it made my skin smooth specially around my chin which I get a lot of clogged pores and stubborn whiteheads that the daily microfoliant doesn't remove by itself. Dermalogica please don't discontinue this. You unexpextedly made this year as my 'Glow-up-era'. 🩷
I received a sample size, love the texture, my skin feels instantly renewed

I have only used this product once so far but I loved how smooth my skin felt afterwards. It does make my skin tingle so I was very careful to time its removal. I wasn't impressed with the method of dispensing the product but my feelings may change with more applications.

I love that this is a quick and easy peel that can be used often. I have another that is stronger that I used weekly. At first, I wasn't sure that this one would be needed. After trying it, I think my skin really benefits from a more frequent peel. I love how gentle this was. There was no irritation after it at all. Will buy again for sure!

avis.titre: A little goes a long way
avis.texte: This peelfoilant is gentle but very effective for clearing my skin. I appreciate that the mask can be used and rinsed off quickly, making it very convenient! My skin is never irritated or red after use, even after it tingles.

I was recommended this product by my esthetician. Ive used products similar to this that were very aggressive. This one was very gentle but affective. I got a small sample from her and the minute i ran out i ran to ulta to buy the fullsize. The price is high BUT it is worth it and you get so much use out of it. This product will last a very long time with only the little amount you have to use. Dermologica is one of my favorite brands with such luxurious ingredients.
I have tried many many pills but this exceeds everything it's supposed to do and then some this stuff is amazing it's like gold love love love love it
I have been using this for about 2 weeks. I do not see any improvement in my pore size. I am planning to try pore mist and the superfoliant exfoliator

I have skin that doesn't slough off as fast as it should, so I need extra help with exfoliation. I do get peels but sometimes life doesn't allow for that kind of investment... so when I saw this, I was so happy. It's even better than I thought. I felt a little tingle but nothing painful and it disappeared quickly. I've been using this for 3 weeks and my skin looks great, I can almost go without makeup! (Which at 39 is awesome to me) The dullness is gone, my skin is bright, hydrated, balanced, and glowing. Love, love, love!
I'm not seeing any changes in my skin after using the product. Maybe not long enough using it but don't even feel tingling or see redness.

This might just have eclipsed Daily Microfoliant as my favorite exfoliating product to smooth and clear my pores! My skin is much smoother after use and it has helped with the deep clogged pores along my jawline and whiteheads on my nose. I have sun damage on my cheekbones that seems to be a bit lighter already. I will definitely continue to incorporate into my skincare routine and would love to see a refill option.
Absolutely love the liquid peelfoliant. It makes my skin super smooth. will definitely work up to one once every day.
Noticeable difference in both look and feel within a short time. Don't be afraid of the tingling, it just means it's working.

avis.titre: I would definitely add this to my skincare routine!
avis.texte: I was gifted by Dermalogica - Ulta for honest review. I really liked using this chemical peel! I have had professional chemical peels done before and this left my skin looking just as good! I am excited to add this to my skincare routine and seeing the benefits of using this peel more regularly!

I am very happy with this product. My skin was already in good condition and I wonder how it will change my face. I tried it at night for once. The next day my skin looks flawless! It literally looks like I have foundation on and there are no pores, fine lines, or wrinkles. I don't see a strong brightening effect but this liquid peelfoliant is very effective and doesn't cause any irritation on my sensitive skin. *gifted by dermalogica
This peel was great. It made my skin feel soft. I have been looking for something to add to my skin routine and help with texture and fine line and this did the job definitely a must buy. Gifted item

This is a really good product that I'm enjoying using. It leaves my akin really soft and doesn't irritate it. My makeup lays perfectly on my skin after using this stuff. Reminds of the paulas choice exfoliant and it's just as good too. Gifted by dermologica.

Complimentary from Dermalogica. I really like how well this works, but it's definitely a product you need to be consistent with! It's such a great product to help clear out my pores and reduce the appearance of them. It was not harsh at all, and I like how it makes my skin feel soft and clear. Just be aware if you have sensitive skin.
Love this serum after cleansing my face because I struggle with pores and uneven skin tone before I get Mother Nature. I apply moisturizer after the serum and call it a night. Amazing!

Gifted by Dermalogica I haven't used an at home skin peel product so I didn't know what to expect and I was pleasantly surprised at how smooth my skin felt after only one use! Before using this, my skin felt rough and no matter how much moisturizer I used I felt like I couldn't get my skin to feel soft and even. I would agree that you have to build up to using it more often than twice a week once a day to begin with. I would definitely recommend this. I wish it came in a smaller size

I received this complimentary from Dermalogica! Unfortunately this was a deluxe sample and I don't think I used enough product. I love all of their products but I couldn't tell a difference with it but it felt very refreshing! Need to get a bigger size so I can try it again!

Dermalogica gifted me the Liquid Peelfoliant. I cleanse, apply this for 2 minutes and rinse it off. I am impressed by how gentle it is with 30% acids and enzymes. I have noticed improvements in my fine lines, clogged pores, and brighter skin.

I only received a tiny sample size so it's hard to give a full review but I will say the tingle is very very mild. It does have a fragrance but it's not terribly strong and in my opinion it smells good. I was only able to use this three times but I didn't notice a real difference honestly which I was a little surprised by because they advertise to minimize pores and even skin tone after just one use. I would love to see if it makes a difference after prolonged use so I may purchase the full size. This sample was gifted by dermalogica.

It is a lovely exfoliant. I use it twice a week in the evening. I love that it doesn't have any strong scent. I only need a tiny amount and easily apply it to my face. The next morning, my skin feels smoother. Having used it for several weeks now, I feel that my skin looks more balanced and overall just fresher. Plus the product doesn't irritate my skin at all. Gifted by Dermalogica

[Gifted by dermalogica] I was sent a really tiny sample of the Liquid Peelfoliant. Although I had high hopes for it, it was difficult to really get much of a result in such few uses. In the few times I did get to use it, I did not experience any irritation or discomfort.

I'll be honest, I can't say for sure how I feel about this product. I was nervous trying it because I didn't want to feel any sort of burn. I followed directions and I didn't feel any pain, but I'm not sure I saw any benefit, either. I know these work over time, but it's impossible to say.

Gifted by Dermalogica. I think this is a nice exfoliating liquid peel. It makes my skin look and feel renewed. It tingles a little bit, but I only leave it on for about a minute before I wash it off. I only tried a little bit, but I liked it.

I am a big fan of Dermalogica and I love a lot of their products but with this one I can't tell yet. Honestly I was very disappointed when I received a little sample, is not enough to test it. It has some great ingredients like tranexamic acid, it feels gentle, it doesn't sting or irritate my skin and it's a pretty pink/purple color. That's all I can say right now. Gifted by Dermalogica.

Listen, I've only used this once, so I can't report on it's efficacy. I will say it has a medicinal smell, and a warm tingling sensation (a good sign that the light chemical peel aspect was working, I will continue to use it). BUT. I was really unhappy when I opened the package to reveal a dull greyish pink bottle. The package and product shows a bright pepto pink fluid, while the product itself is nothing like that. I don't appreciate false advertising, period. I know its just a color but its the principle of the matter. I would submit a photo but there's no option to do so in this review form.

Gifted by dermolagica! I love how lightweight this serum is! It really helps to exfoliate the skin and brighten! It love using it at night for that glow in the morning! A little goes a long way so this will last you a long time!

avis.titre: A Serum for Aging without Retinol
avis.texte: While the line up of ingredients is quite nice, I did not feel I saw immediate results like I would have hoped. If you are looking for a serum that targets signs of aging without retinol I would give this a try. I do however love so many Dermalogica products, I just might not be as patient as I should.

Introducing Dermalogica's new Liquid Peelfoliant - a daily exfoliating peel that smooths fine lines, unclogs pores, evens skin tone, and delivers immediate results. Key ingredients include AHA, BHA, PHA, and Tranexamic acids for exfoliation and brightening, plus a lipid-rich blend for hydration and radiance. Don't forget to use sunscreen for lasting benefits.

I loved using Dermalogica's liquid peelfoliant. I was gifted by Dermalogica - Ulta for my review. You massage the peel on to your skin and then rinse after 1-3 minutes. After using for a few days I noticed my skin tone was more even and felt so smooth. I noticed a slight tingle at first but after rinsing my skin felt great. I also like that it's vegan and cruelty fee! I would highly recommend this product!

I was not sure what to expect from this product. I got a sample size which was good for a few uses and I noticed that my skin looked more even toned and the texture was more smooth. I am interested in purchasing the full size. Gifted by Dermalogica - Ulta

As much as I enjoyed using this Liquid Peelfoliant gifted by Dermalogica ,I so wish it came in a bigger size so that I could use it a multiple times before I could share my honest opinion PS. my opinion is based on one time use only. This liquid exfoliant peel off worked well in making my skin smooth and refreshed. Its contains AHA, PHA , Phytic acid , Upcycled Cranberry extract , ceramides, etc which are all great for a clean, clear , youthful ,and glowing skin. It did have a little tingling sensation which indicates that the product is working its magic. It is fragrance free and the product spreads well. I enjoyed using this.

avis.titre: I would buy this product again and again
avis.texte: This product is a must try. As soon as I apply to my face, it gives off a softening and smoothing effect that I find myself reaching for time and time again this is a must have must try 10 out of 10 product. Gifted by Dermalogica.

Love using this face peel! Really unclogs my pores and makes more even skin tone. I have noticed that it minimizes my pores just after a few uses. Great results on the overall skin condition. Gifted by Dermologica

This product helped my pores, I did see a change after the first use. It did not irritate my skin nor did it make me break out. I also noticed I didn't have redness as I normally do. Overall I do recommend this product for those with sensitive skin. Gifted by Dermalogica

This is a really nice exfoliant. It makes the skin super smooth and feel soft and actually helps remove some rough skin so some small wrinkles appear smaller. It could make your skin sensitive if you're not used to exfoliants but it's very effective. I received this complimentary from Dermalogica-Ulta.

I was gifted a small sample of this by dermalogica for review. I am a regular AHA/BHA user so this did not irritate my skin at all. It does have a sort of "instant" smoothing effect, but I'm not sure how permanent it is. Unfortunately there's not enough in my sample to try it long-term, but I do think it's useful to use the night before you're planning to wear makeup, as the makeup will go on more smoothly and not sink into pores quite as much. I liked the smoothing effect and how gentle it was. It only takes a few drops so I do think a larger bottle would last quite some time. Complimentary from dermalogica.

I love using a liquid exfoliant and was super excited to try this peelfoliant gifted by Dermalogica. I got a sample size to try. I followed the direction and applied on my dry skin and then washed it off as directed. Honestly, I didn't notice any difference whatsoever. I had even left it on for a little bit longer the next time but still saw no difference. The skin texture and roughness was still there unfortunately:(

This Liquid Peelfoliant has a lightweight and watery consistency. It is easy to apply and spreads effortlessly on the skin. Just a small amount is enough for the entire face. This peel is gentle yet effective; after using it, my face feels smooth and refined. It has helped minimize the appearance of uneven texture, leaving my complexion looking refreshed and rejuvenated. Gifted by Dermalogica

I definitely notice a difference after the first use! I felt a slight tingle, but nothing too harsh! My skin felt so smooth after! I was sent a sample complimentary from Dermologica. Not sure if I would buy the full-size since it is a little pricey.

Gifted by Dermalogica - Ulta for an honest review. Upon my first use, I experienced a gentle tingling sensation that subsided after leaving it on for a while. Once washed off, my face felt exceptionally soft and refreshed. Although unsure of its long-term effects, the experience was delightful!

Dermalogica gifted me the Liquid Peelfoliant. This quick peel is applied to a clean face and easily washes off. My face looks smoother with improvement in my pores. This also help with uneven skin tone too.

I am absolutely in love with this brand, and this peel has quickly become my favorite product! I've started using it every day, and I can already see noticeable improvements: my pores appear smaller, and my skin looks much smoother. It's definitely working wonders for me! Moreover, the fragrance of the peel is simply amazing. I feel fortunate to have been gifted by Dermalogica.

I cannot tell if the product works at reducing wrinkles or not because I was given a teeny tiny thing however, after using it once it did make my face a lot smoother and in this dry hot California weather, it did help curb the appearance of large pores. But is this worth the purchase? I cannot tell you. The amount of the product given wasn't enough to tell the results. This was gifted to me btw.

I received this product complimentary from Dermalogica. The sample size that I received, was very small, so I can only give a review from using it one time. It was a gentle peel that did not irritate my skin. From the one time I was able to use it, me skin felt more soft.

Dermalogica is one of my favorite skincare brands and I was so excited to try a sample or their Liquid Peelfoliant. This is a daily peel, with ablend of acids and enzymes. I have sensitive skin, but didn't notice any irritation or issues with the peel. I do think it is pretty gentle, which also means the results are not crazy obvious. I noticed some brightening, but would need to use it more to see more results. Gifted by Dermalogica

My skin has never felt smoother than after using this product. The packaging is sleek and perfect. The application works very well. It goes on your skin smoothly and doesn't cause irritation. I recommend this. Gifted by dermalogica-ulta.

avis.titre: I would like to see results
avis.texte: This product was gifted to me by dermalogica for my honest review. I would like to say that I loved this product, but the sample size was so small and only half full there was not enough product to cover my face. I also believe with skincare it should be used more than once for an honest review. I couldn't even use it one time on my entire face. It looks like a good product though.

I am an avid peel user so I was excited to try this product. My skin is quite tough, so using this every day wasnt a problem for me. It was strong enough that I could feel it working and definitely helped my pores after a week. This was gifted by dermalogica - ulta.

I was gifted the Liquid Peelfoliant complimentary from dermalogica and was super excited to receive it. I have tried it out and so far, I enjoy using the product; it provides the opportunity to use a great chemical peel but at home for a fraction of the cost. I cannot wait to see the ongoing effects of this product as I continue to use it more and more!

I recently had the pleasure of trying out the Liquid Peelfoliant, and I must say, it has been a game-changer for my skincare routine. This product promises to deliver a gentle yet effective exfoliation, and it certainly lives up to its claims. From the moment I applied the Liquid Peelfoliant, I could feel its soothing and refreshing texture on my skin. The application process was a breeze, and I appreciated how it didn't cause any irritation or discomfort. The formula is packed with skin-loving ingredients that work together to slough away dead skin cells and impurities, leaving my skin looking brighter and feeling incredibly smooth. Complimentary from Dermalogica

This liquid peelfoliant is incredible! In just one use I noticed more even toned skin right away. My pores were reduced, my skin felt soft and my redness faded. It's so quick and easy to use. I left it on for 2 minutes then rinsed it off. What a difference 2 minutes makes! There was a very slight tingle but that only lasted a few seconds. I'm loving the results so far, and I can't wait to see what it does for wrinkles with continued use. This was gifted by Dermalogica.

I've been loving using the Dermalogica peel, it really helps to clear any texture and acne that I have. It doesn't feel harsh on my skin which I love. It goes so well with my other Dermalogica products! Gifted by Dermalogica

avis.titre: great for a smooth clear complexion
avis.texte: I much prefer this style of exfoliant versus using scrubs and other products. This peel has improved my skins texture and pores and also played a role in acne reduction. My skin seems to tolerate it quite well and my complexion has noticeably improved in just a few days. I was gifted this product complimentary from Dermalogica.

Great chemical exfoliant. It is a strong product so I don't recommend for those with sensitive skin or if you've never used high dose chemical exfoliants. Overall leaves your skin feeling softer. Sample size gifted by Dermalogica. Not sure if I'd buy the full size.

A good way to get rid of stubborn little dead cells that you want to take of gently without damaging your skin. My face was a little red after using it but it calmed out fast. Refreshing feeling of your skin being soft and new. Gifted by dermalogica

I am in love with this peel! I can actually see the difference immediately after 1 use. After using it consistently for the last week, I can see that my pores have minimized and my skin is brighter. It's easy to use as well. Complimentary from Dermalogica for my honest review.

This has such a nice consistency and feel. It's really easy to use and works very quickly to gently and effectively exfoliate my skin. It leaves my skin feeling soft and smooth. I have large pores and it seems to be helping with the appearance of my pores. My only complaint is since I received a deluxe sample size I did not have enough product to test for a long period of time. * Gifted by Dermalogica

Wow! I saw results after the first use. It left my skin feeling soft and supple and it was glowing. It wasn't harsh on the skin and it was very easy to use only having to leave it on for 2/3 minutes. Gifted by dermalogica

Gifted by Dermalogica. Apply on clean dry skin, the Liquid Peelfoliant works as a gentle liquid exfoliant. Massaging the product to activate exfoliation and left on for 1-3 minutes. After rinse off, skin feels smooth, clean, and slightly brighten.
